title: security: RBAC v2 - enforce KMS region pinning and audit logging hardening
author: Asha Patel
description: Context: Customers with strict data residency requirements and enterprise KMS integrations have asked for stronger enforcement that keys used for customer data remain region-pinned and are auditable. RBAC v1 had ad-hoc checks in the API layer; RBAC v2 centralizes policy enforcement and auditability. This PR implements enforcement of KMS region pinning at the RBAC v2 enforcer boundary, adds structured audit logs for cross-region KMS operations, and includes migration helpers and tests. Motivation: close a gap where requests could be routed to a KMS in a different region if service routing changed, creating a compliance exposure. Changes are limited to server-side enforcement and audit surfaces; no public API changes expected. Checklist: - [x] Add RBAC v2 policy rule and enforcement hooks for KMS key residency (internal/rbac/v2/policy_enforcer.go) - [x] Add KMS region pinning utility and validators (internal/kms/region_pin.go) - [x] Emit structured audit events for KMS key usage and residency violations (pkg/audit/auditlog.go) - [x] Add automated migration script to tag existing keys with residency metadata (scripts/migrate_kms_residency.sql) - [x] Add integration tests against KMS emulator and unit tests for policy enforcement (internal/rbac/v2/*_test.go) - [x] Update RBAC schema with residency constraints (config/schemas/rbac_v2_schema.yaml) - [x] Add operator docs and migration steps (docs/security/kms-region-pinning.md) Commits summary: - 7f3c2d4: add KMS residency validator and unit tests - 9a1b8f0: wire validator into RBAC v2 enforcer with policy check - 2d8f4b1: emit structured audit events for residency checks and failures - 5c7a1e2: migration SQL and helper CLI to tag keys - 8b12c9f: tests, docs, and minor lint fixes Changed areas (high-level): [internal/rbac/v2/*] policy enforcer and tests; [internal/kms/*] region pin utilities and validators; [pkg/audit/*] structured audit events and serializers; [config/schemas/*] RBAC v2 schema changes; [scripts/*] migration SQL and CLI helper; [docs/*] operator migration guide; [deploy/helm/*] optional flag to enable enforcement in Private deploys. Review conversation summary: - Diego Morales (reviewer) asked for explicit unit tests around error paths and a benchmark of the enforcer hot path. Author (Asha) added targeted unit tests and micro-benchmarks showing ~0.6% median latency impact with caching enabled. - Lena Kim requested clearer audit field names and a retention note; updated audit schema and doc with retention guidance. - Omar Farouk flagged a potential race during key metadata migration in high-throughput Dedicated clusters; added a migration CLI that tags keys idempotently and a helm hook to rollout gradually. - Security review (SEC) requested a safety toggle for operators to opt-out during migration windows; implemented a helm values flag enable_rbac_kms_pin_enforcement with default true and documented rollback steps. CI history: - CI / unit-tests: failed first run due to a flaky rbac_cache_test, re-run passed - CI / linters: pass - CI / integration-e2e (KMS emulator): pass - CI / performance-smoke: pass Merge outcome: Squash-and-merge after two approvals and green CI. Merged to main on 2026-02-18. A backport PR to release/2026-02 was created as follow-up. Ops notes: Customers with existing keys will be guided through a migration that tags key residency; enforcement will be toggleable via helm values for Private installs while teams complete migration. No immediate customer-facing behavior change until operators enable enforcement. Rollout plan is documented in docs/security/kms-region-pinning.md.
